per_scenario_events.explanation: The Premium table has a single source column (policy_amount_identifier), and the agent correctly modeled: (1) an owl:Class Premium with a business-meaningful rdfs:comment and label; (2) an owl:DatatypeProperty for the sole column with domain/range and a descriptive comment; (3) the FK relationship (policy_amount_identifier → Policy_Amount) modeled as an owl:ObjectProperty hasPolicyAmount with correct rdfs:domain/rdfs:range and mapsToColumn, appended via append_fk_triples and confirmed success. Neptune persistence succeeded (26 triples). The class also carries rich annotations (businessPurpose, businessConcepts, referenceTables, sampleData, notes) beyond the minimum. The only shortfall across the session is the Glue metadata update failing due to Lake Formation permissions, but the task explicitly treats this as expected/non-blocking and the agent correctly reported it without treating it as a hard failure. All three scoring axes (coverage, relationship modeling, annotation quality) are strong for this table: exactly one class, the one column has a datatype property with domain/range, the FK is modeled as an ObjectProperty, and comments are business-meaningful rather than restated column names.
